notes: Two written 'the's in 'the midst of the valley': the present article (s017) takes the one standing before 'valley' and the construct 'midst' takes a supplied one, which is rule 29's arthrous-rectum counting rather than fronting.
'The hand of Jehovah' and 'the Spirit of Jehovah' have no article morpheme in the chain (both recta are the divine name), so each construct rightly takes a supplied 'the'.
The 'of' in 'full of bones' is the function word English supplies for the accusative complement of the adjective and belongs to the noun's unit under rule 33; it is not 'added'.
